note: laneSHADOWCACHE (SHADOWCACHE v1). Read by Scripts/ShadowCache.cs. ALL OFF: master enabled=false and every switch enabled=false; missing file = off. S0 measure only (changes nothing, logs how often the sun cascades would have to be re-captured), S1 mixed cached sun cascades (static environment cached, fighters every frame; needs HDRP asset allowDirectionalMixedCachedShadows=1), S2 cascade age stagger (needs no asset flag; a stale cascade is stale for fighters too). Runtime A/B on one exe: -shadowcache:S0 | S1 | S2 | none, -noshadowcache:S1, -shadowcachereport. Do not combine S1 with OPT3 G1. Every number is a margin or a cadence, not a measurement: see MANIFEST.md.
